other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered farmer
Applicant must cultivate paddy in the Kharif season of 2012-13
Applicant must possess a valid landholding certificate or proof of cultivation
Applicant must be associated with Primary Agriculture Credit Societies (PACS) or Large Area Multipurpose Cooperative Societies (LAMPS)
Preference is given to small and marginal farmers
benefits_summary: Farmers receive paddy procurement at MSP of ₹1250 per quintal for Common grade and ₹1280 per quintal for Grade A, with direct payment to the farmer.
documents_required: Valid landholding certificate or proof of cultivation
